answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Every claim climbs the grove of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the meadow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. By the garden of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
